newsitem.title: PERU: Tremor shakes Peruvian coast, no damages reported.
newsitem.headline: Tremor shakes Peruvian coast, no damages reported.

text.p: A tremor registering 4.5 on the Richter scale shook Peru's Pacific coast, including Lima, on Tuesday, but no damage was reported.
The Peruvian Geophysical Institute said the tremor, at 6:10 p.m. (1110 GMT), lasted for five minutes and had its epicentre 50 miles (80 km) south of Lima.
Institute analyst Porfirio Huaco said the tremor, with a depth of 16 miles (25 km), caused no damage or injuries.
The tremor caused widespread panic along the heavily opulated coastal area, particularly in the southern city of Ica where it was most strongly felt, he added.
